description_ru: Покупательница возвращает куртку в магазин и просит обмен.
text:
Customer: Excuse me, I bought this jacket here last week, but I'm afraid it doesn't fit.
Assistant: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
Customer: Yes, here it is. I haven't worn the jacket at all. The label is still on it.
Assistant: Thank you. Would you like a refund, or would you prefer to exchange it for another size?
Customer: I would like a bigger size, if you have one. This one is a medium, and the sleeves are too short.
Assistant: Let me check. Hmm, we have run out of large jackets in blue, but we have one in green.
Customer: Green is not really my colour. If you can order a blue one, I will wait.
Assistant: It would take about five days to arrive. Alternatively, I can give you your money back today.
Customer: How long would a refund take?
Assistant: The money will go back to your card in three working days.
Customer: I think I'll wait for the blue jacket. Will you call me when it comes?
Assistant: Of course. Could you write your phone number here?
Customer: Certainly. It's the same number as on the receipt, but I have added a new last digit.
Assistant: Thank you very much. We will call you as soon as it arrives. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Customer: No, that's everything. Thanks for your help!

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Верхние зубы слегка касаются нижней губы, звук звонкий; не оглушайте его в «ф».
Звонкие согласные в конце слова не оглушайте: say «bad», а не «бат»; сохраняйте вибрацию голоса, но не добавляйте гласную.
Кончик языка касается дёсен за верхними зубами, а спинка языка отодвинута назад; звук твёрдый, но не «ль» и не «в».

questions.question: Why does the customer return the jacket?
questions.answer: It doesn't fit; the sleeves are too short.

questions.question: How long will the blue jacket take to arrive?
